overview: Use this workbook as the controlled terminology reference for SAMT. English is the engineering working language; user-facing product content is Arabic-first and RTL. Preserve original technical identifiers and evidence names. Terms marked Mixed or LTR require bidirectional isolation in Arabic interfaces. Repository-specific terminology may be added only after the relevant capability is verified in code.

guidance.Guidance: Custom GPT responses and engineering documentation are in English unless Arabic UI content is specifically requested.
SAMT is Arabic-first and RTL by default.
Preserve original source names, article titles, URLs, identifiers and technical codes when required for evidence.
Use bdi, dir="ltr", Unicode isolation or an equivalent method for LTR identifiers embedded in Arabic.
Prefer approved institutional and intelligence terminology over literal machine translation.
Use one preferred Arabic term across navigation, tooltips, reports and alerts unless a documented domain distinction exists.
Do not translate an official claim in a way that implies verification.
Use explicit unavailable or degraded states; never translate absence into zero.
Use the exact Arabic label بيانات تجريبية غير حية for simulated operational data.
Use Arabic formatting with Asia/Dubai as the default operational timezone and provide UTC where needed.
Do not translate or reverse aircraft registrations, vessel identifiers, airport codes, stock tickers, coordinates or source IDs.
High-impact military, legal, health and financial terminology requires specialist review before production release.
